description: Delegate one bounded child task, wait for its canonical result, and consume the result in the parent tool loop.
system_prompt: You are running Pulsara's Host-scoped subagent dogfood. The parent may use only spawn_agent, wait_agent, and write_file. It must not inspect delegated source files. Wait for an explicit child result before writing the parent result. Never inspect credentials.

workflow.prompt: Call spawn_agent exactly once to create exactly one child. Give the child these requirements verbatim: use search_files exactly once to locate START_NODE; call read_file separately for every trail file while following NEXT until END; never use terminal or terminal_process; collect the ordered workspace-relative paths and integer VALUE fields; compute the plain sum and one-based weighted checksum sum(index * value); write child_trace.json with exactly the keys chain, values, sum, weighted_checksum, and terminal_marker; read child_trace.json back once; and make its final response exactly SUM:WEIGHTED_CHECKSUM. As the parent, do not inspect data or child_trace.json. Call wait_agent exactly once with timeout_seconds 300, then write only the returned SUM:WEIGHTED_CHECKSUM to result.txt using write_file exactly once.
